	static long mod = 998244353;
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		FastScanner sc = new FastScanner();
		long n = sc.nextInt();
		long m = sc.nextInt();
		long L = sc.nextInt();
		long R = sc.nextInt();
		if(n % 2 == 1 && m % 2 == 1) {
			System.out.println(pow((R-L+1) % mod, n*m));
		}
		else {
			if((R - L + 1) % 2 == 0) {
				long allbutone = pow((R-L+1) % mod, n*m-1);
				long res = allbutone * ((R-L+1)/2) % mod;
				System.out.println(res);
			}

			}
		}

	static class Matrix{
		long[][] mat = new long[2][2];
		public Matrix(long a, long b, long c, long d) {
			mat[0][0] = a;
			mat[0][1] = b;
			mat[1][0] = c;
			mat[1][1] = d;
		}
		public Matrix(long[][] mat) {
			this.mat = mat;
		}
		public Matrix pow(long x) {
			Matrix res = new Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1);
			Matrix a = new Matrix(mat);
			while(x > 0) {
				if(x % 2 == 1) {
					res = res.mult(a);
				}
				a = a.mult(a);
				x /= 2;
			}
			return res;
		}

			long[][] rmat = new long[2][2];
			for(int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
				for(int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {

						rmat[i][j] += mat[i][k] * m.mat[k][j];
						rmat[i][j] %= mod;
					}
				}
			}
			return new Matrix(rmat);
		}
		public String toString() {

			mat[0][0]+" "+mat[0][1]+"\n"+

		}
	}
